usedFor: AirSlate connects a workflow to your CRM system with “Integrate with CRM”, started by events elsewhere.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Integrate with CRM” in AirSlate
bestTemplate.why: Each new meeting can start “Integrate with CRM”, which connects a workflow to your CRM system.

watchOut: Check which CRM system “Integrate with CRM” connects to before an automation runs it.
